verdict.rationale: Angular is a framework that runs entirely on the user's own machines and infrastructure. Its source is public on GitHub (angular-gh-1). It is installed locally from npm (angular-gh-5). The CLI creates workspaces, serves apps locally and compiles them into a dist/ folder that the user deploys wherever they choose (angular-docs-9, angular-docs-10, angular-docs-22, angular-docs-19). Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement in the evidence, any first-party documentation framed around self-hosting or offline/vendor-independent use, and independent corroboration of running it with no external dependencies.
